notes.title: Box:Boxing 1.3.1
notes.content:
[b]Update Highlights:[/b]
Improved enemy AI. The enemy now blocks, evades and counters the player's punches.

notes.title: Box:Boxing 1.1.0
notes.content:
[b]Update highlights:[/b]
- Added Options button to pause menu
- Changed pause menu button from left oculus button to X or A buttons
- Added view reset by pressing Y or B buttons
- Optimized rainy environment
- Added audio volume option to options menu
- Added cpu mode difficulty option to options menu
- Improved enemy AI
- Tutorial now also tells how to block, how to reset view and how to open the pause menu
